A quick warm-up on the keys you're due to review

Letters you picked up a while ago but haven't touched in a few sessions get surfaced first, as a short warm-up at the start of your practice. So don't be surprised to revisit an old friend before meeting anyone new.

Letters quietly fade if you leave them alone

Skills rust when they go unused, and KeyLearn reflects that honestly. A key you haven't practiced in a long time slowly loses a little confidence over real time, so you might see an old letter drift back from green toward red on its own. That's not you getting worse — it's the app gently flagging that the letter is due for a refresh before it truly slips. Your best-ever result for a key is never wiped out; only the current reading softens.

Ako je ova opcija omogućena, morat ćete podići fokusiranu tipku i sve prethodne tipke iznad ciljne brzine. To će otežati otključavanje novih tipki. Međutim, to će također otežati zaboravljanje starih tipki.

y8v2PQLa.value: The classic touch-typing course: a fixed, finger-by-finger march through the keyboard — home row first, then the top and bottom rows. Familiar if you learned on TypingClub or Mavis Beacon. The one twist is that it’s adaptive — the next stage unlocks only once you’ve mastered the keys you’re on.

children.value: Odabrali smo nekoliko primjera profila kako bismo vam pokazali kako ljudi napreduju u učenju tipkanja dodirom prilikom korištenja ove aplikacije. To su stvarni, anonimizirani korisnički profili. Nadamo se da će vas nadahnuti da nastavite učiti!

z5j83IHe.value: Skills fade when you stop using them. With this on, KeyLearn keeps an eye on how long it's been since you last drilled each key and quietly brings back the ones that are due — spaced-repetition review woven into your practice. Once every key is unlocked, your sessions turn into targeted refreshers of whatever has gone rusty, so your hard-won speed sticks.

children.value: Kada počnete upisivati generirane riječi, računalo prikuplja vašu statistiku tipkanja. Pokazatelji počinju mijenjati svoje boje iz crvene u zelenu. Crvena boja znači da je brzina tipkanja za taj pojedinačni ključ spora, a zelena boja označava suprotno. U ovoj fazi vaš je cilj učiniti sva slova zelenima poboljšavajući brzinu tipkanja. Imajte na umu da je u ovom primjeru slovo „

” istaknuto jer ima najgoru metriku brzine tipkanja, pa postaje ciljno slovo. Ciljno slovo uključeno je u svaku generiranu riječ i ovo je ključna informacija koju treba znati. To znači da u bilo kojem trenutku vježbate točan ključ koji vam zadaje najviše problema.
